Name: Farm Stall
Author: Stoel1994
Description:
[center]DO YOU LIKE NEW AGE FARMING?[/center][center]﻿
Good, because I'm all about that junk.

Introducing... the Farm Stall.
A poorly made budget honesty box.
Take the stuff to robin!
Tell her to get to work!
Grow or make your stuff!
Put the things IN THE THINGS!
PROFITTTTTTTTTTTTTT!

The Farm Stall works the way a traditional honesty box does. Are you gonna sell some stuff? Maybe. Is somebody going to come along and not have enough money to buy it? Sure, this is Stardew Valley after all. They might pay you in other things, they might not pay you at all. Heck, you could just have NOBODY turn up and sell NOTHINGGGGGGGG!

The stall comprises of 3 parts:
A rundown shelf, where you can place your shelf... stuff. fruit, veggies, flowers, assorted tree tappings. you know, the usual.
A fridge. for all those things you gotta keep cold. Milk, Eggs, Fish, Cheese, Mayonnaise.. The essentials.
The OUTPUT CHEST - If you are confused about what this is, please look up the word "Output". it should give you a rough idea.

At the start of each day you will get a message telling you if anything has shifted overnight. while the money is given straight to you, you will need to check on any possible OUTPUTS (hint hint) you may have received.

Things may seem slow at first, but this is by design. I want my mod to feel organic, natural, cozy. The more hearts you have with a villager, the more likely they will be to come in your box and empty it. So get friendly![/center]
